items.name: get_overview
items.description: Headline KPIs (sessions, watch time, active and new users, completion) for a period, with the change against the previous period.

items.name: get_me
items.description: Describes the credential used for this connection: how it authenticates and which scopes it holds.

items.name: get_views
items.description: Viewing sessions by day, hour, weekday, timezone; completion by weekday; retention curve; drop episodes and resume behavior. Period 7/30/90 days.
items.summary: Sessions, completion, retention and drop analysis

items.name: list_top_anime
items.description: Paginated anime table: sessions, watch hours, completion rate, new viewers, quadrant (popularity vs completion), genres, formats, languages, new vs back catalog. Filter by format (all, tv, movie, ova). Period 7/30/90 days.
items.summary: Top anime, genres, formats and catalog analysis

items.name: get_users_summary
items.description: User count by segment (new, regular, power, dormant, at_risk, never_watched), seniority (age buckets), and active sessions. No period parameter.
items.summary: User segments, seniority and active sessions

items.name: list_users
items.description: Paginated user directory: user_id, created_at, last_activity, sessions, watch_hours, segment. Token cannot search (q) or sort by pseudo. Allowed sort: user_id, created_at, last_activity, sessions, watch_hours, pseudo (admin only).
items.summary: User directory with segments and activity

items.name: get_user
items.description: User detail: id, created_at, segment, recent sessions (10), progress on ongoing episodes (50). No email. Token does not see pseudo.
items.summary: User profile, recent sessions and progress

items.name: get_growth
items.description: Growth metrics: DAU/WAU/MAU, stickiness, signups per week, cumulative users, funnel (signup→first→3 episodes→J7→J30), retention cohorts (J1/J7/J14/J30), time-to-first-session buckets, churn. Period 7/30/90 days. Contains cohorts and funnel keys in response.

items.name: get_retention
items.description: Retention cohorts from growth endpoint: signup weeks and J1/J7/J14/J30 retention %. Period 7/30/90 days. Extracts cohorts from get_growth response.

items.name: get_funnel
items.description: Signup funnel from growth endpoint: signup, first session, 3 episodes, active at J7, active at J30 with conversion %. Period 7/30/90 days. Extracts funnel from get_growth response.

items.name: get_player_health
items.description: Player health: active sessions (null if not measured), error rate (errors/sessions), startup p50/p95 (not measured), sources count and failing, cache data. Period 7/30/90 days.
items.summary: Playback errors, startup latency and source health

items.name: list_playback_errors
items.description: Grouped playback errors (code, anime_id, episode, source): occurrence count, first_seen, last_seen. Filter by code or since. Paginated. since max 90 days back.
items.summary: Playback errors grouped by code and context

items.name: get_errors_summary
items.description: Error summary: total count and KPI vs previous period, by code with count and probable cause (file list), daily trend by code. Period 7/30/90 days.
items.summary: Error summary, probable causes and daily trend

items.name: get_sources_health
items.description: Source/tracker failures: count, share %, last seen (RFC3339). Attempts per source not measured. Period 7/30/90 days.
items.summary: Source failure rates and health status

items.name: get_costs
items.description: Usage (watch_hours, sessions, active_users, peak_concurrent) and costs (server, bandwidth, storage, total) with measured flags. Money is null with measured:false when cost inputs are missing. Period 7/30/90 days.

items.name: list_issues
items.description: Paginated issues (findings raised by Claude or admin): id, created_at, updated_at, severity (low, medium, high, critical), status (new, in_progress, resolved), title. Filter by status or severity.

items.name: get_issue
items.description: Issue detail: id, status, severity, title, evidence, suggested_fix, source, notes, created_at, updated_at.

items.name: set_issue_status
items.description: Reversible action: with dry_run:false it runs immediately, is budgeted per hour, and returns an undo_token. dry_run defaults to true. Set the status of an issue and optionally replace its triage note.

items.name: create_issue
items.description: Reversible action: with dry_run:false it runs immediately, is budgeted per hour, and returns an undo_token. dry_run defaults to true. Raise a new issue (finding) with status new.

items.name: add_note
items.description: Reversible action: with dry_run:false it runs immediately, is budgeted per hour, and returns an undo_token. dry_run defaults to true. Append a line to the triage note of an issue.

items.name: set_alert_threshold
items.description: Sensitive action: it never runs by itself. dry_run:false files a pending approval for a human (returns approval_id); follow it with get_approval. dry_run defaults to true. Change an alert threshold. Allowed rules and bounds: error_rate_pct 0.1-50, startup_p95_s 0.5-60, stream_saturation_pct 10-100, disk_pct 50-99.

items.name: get_approval
items.description: Follow a pending approval: its status (pending, approved, rejected, failed, undone), who decided, and the result once executed.
